access.bulk: Authorized subscribers may obtain monthly All Companies plus daily/weekly new and changed company files.
access.api: No official read API is offered as the bulk route.
access.search: Public business search is separate from subscriber downloads.

fields.summary: Official site links an XLS business-entity layout and documents tab-delimited company/officer linkage by ID/comptype/compseq; person-bearing officer files are separable from All Companies.

active_status_semantics: All Companies covers all businesses on file, not a verified active-only or operating-business cohort; status code semantics require review.
statewide_completeness: Monthly All Companies is described as all businesses on file statewide, but exact types, counts, exclusions and controls are not published on the landing page.
address_zip: The linked XLS may define company address fields, but organization-controlled address roles and ZIP/ZIP4 suitability were not validated without downloading it.
automation_terms_fees: Kentucky.gov registration and Subscriber Agreement required. Commercial Business Records subscription is $2,000/month; noncommercial fee treatment depends on purpose. Unattended download support is unresolved.
redistribution: Subscriber access is agreement-governed; reviewed pages do not establish downstream retention, transformation, geocoding, publication or redistribution rights.
temporal_refresh: All Companies monthly; new companies daily/weekly; company changes daily. Full replacement, deletion, replay and checksum rules remain unresolved.

citations.evidence: Official datasets, formats, cadence, account/agreement gate and pricing.
Official linked business-entity format workbook; not downloaded in this review.

strongest_next_action: Review unsigned subscriber terms and a non-row-bearing copy of the current layout, then obtain exact All Companies scope/counts, status/address dictionaries, ID lifecycle, full/change/deletion/replay/checksum semantics and explicit downstream rights before registration.
